story.title: Bob on Business: Biz in the front, party in the back as One University Place breaks ground
story.summary: From a mullet to a tycoon, a high-profile property in Fort Worth is now on the rise. On Nov. 19, One University Place broke ground, the second — but likely not the last — project from Goldenrod Cos. That came on the heels of the Nebraska-based firm topping out its Van Zandt development on West 7th Street. Previous attempts to develop the site had fallen short. Goldenrod embarked on One University Place as far back as 2022. One reason is that the property slopes down 30 feet from the western side facing University Drive to the eastern end of the property on Morton Street.
